text:
maria: FYI PR #542 (docs) needs a quick style pass + sample parity check before we merge. aiming for the 4pm PT merge window today. cc @sam @joel

sam: on it. which samples are out of parity?

joel: the python SDK snippet uses `client.generate(...)` but our SDK surface now prefers `client.text.generate(...)` — break in examples and the migration guide. also one migration note references `Dedicated` vs the canonical product name.

kevin: CI docs preview is failing with a 404 on the migration guide link (relative path issue). failing job: `docs:preview` in circle.

maria: thanks. priority list: 1) fix SDK snippet naming 2) terminology consistency (use "Redwood Dedicated" where appropriate) 3) fix broken links 4) run docs-lint and preview.

sam: I can update the SDK snippets and add a short note in the migration guide. i'll push a patch to the PR branch. quick snippet i'll replace: 
```python
# old
client.generate(prompt)
# new
client.text.generate(prompt)
```

joel: i’ll run the style linter and search for product-name variants. quick grep i ran: `grep -R "Dedicated\b" docs/ | sed -n '1,50p'` — a few matches, will prepare a tiny changelist.

kevin: i fixed the relative link in a branch locally — seems the toc link used `../migrations/index.md` instead of `/docs/migrations/index.md`. i can push that as a tiny fix.

maria: perfect. can we get a docs preview URL before 3:45 so i can sign off?

docs-bot: docs preview deployed — https://deploy-preview-542--docs.redwood-inference.dev (status: success)

sam: pushed snippet changes, small tests passed locally. preview shows updated python snippet.

joel: pushed linter fixes and normalized product name to "Redwood Dedicated" across the guide. also trimmed a few passive-voice sentences per style guide.

kevin: pushed link fix. re-running `docs:preview` now.

docs-bot: docs preview updated — https://deploy-preview-542--docs.redwood-inference.dev (status: success)

maria: reviewing now. small nit: in the SDK example please include the import line and note about auth. can you add `from redwood import Client` and a one-line about API key?

sam: added import + auth note. also wrapped the code in a full snippet so copy-paste works.

maria: looks good. i approve. please merge in the 4pm window and add a changelog entry under docs/CHANGELOG.md: "SDK snippet: migrate to client.text.generate; terminology: Redwood Dedicated"

joel: will merge at 4pm PT and add the changelog item. tagging @kevin for release checklist. :thumbsup:

kevin: got it. i'll watch the merge and confirm prod docs route flush.

maria: thanks everyone. small follow-up: create a short lint rule ticket to catch `client.generate` usage in examples so this doesn't slip again. i'll open one after this merges.

sam: thanks — happy to help with the lint rule ticket.

joel: ack. closing thread after merge.
